pages.text: The Electrolyzer turns $(l)Alumina$() into $(l)Aluminum Ingots$() with electricity. You need it early: the first drone frames are made of aluminum, and aluminum cannot be smelted straight from its ore.

The Electrolyzer is a small multiblock. It needs one $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frame$(/l) on its $(l)left$(), as you face its front.$(br)$(li)Place the Electrolyzer.$(br)$(li)Right-click it: a drone shows where the frame goes.$(br)$(li)Place the Cyber Frame there. The machine assembles itself.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: It works only once assembled. Breaking the frame folds it back.

$(li)Put $(l)Alumina$() in the input slot. Ingots come out in the output slot.$(br)$(li)Give it FE. Plug $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l) into its free side, its front or its back: its top is full.$(br)$(li)A hopper underneath takes out only the ingots, never the Alumina still waiting.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)The tab beside its GUI takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l).$(br)You can see it work: the feeder punch behind its window strikes four times per ingot, and alumina grains drop into the bath. If the punch stops, so has the machine.

$(li)$(l)Recipe$(): 1 Alumina -> 1 Aluminum Ingot$(br)$(li)$(l)Time$(): 5 seconds per ingot$(br)$(li)$(l)Power$(): 80 FE/t (8,000 FE per ingot)$(br)$(li)$(l)Energy buffer$(): 20,000 FE$(br)A $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) makes 60 FE/t, so $(l)two$() of them keep the Electrolyzer running. Alumina from other mods works too.
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: See $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum$(/l) for the whole chain, from bauxite ore to ingot.
